prompt:
A wooden crate of mass 25.0 kg is held at rest on a smooth plane inclined at 24.0 degrees to the horizontal.
(Take g = 9.81 m s^-2.)
[FIGURE PLACEHOLDER: Diagram of an inclined plane at 24.0 degrees to the horizontal. A rectangular crate sits on the ramp. A vertical downward arrow labeled W represents weight. Perpendicular axes show components along the incline and perpendicular to the incline.]

(a) Calculate the weight W of the crate. [1]
(b) Calculate the component of the weight acting parallel to the slope down the plane. [1]
(c) Calculate the component of the weight acting perpendicular to the slope into the plane. [1]
mark_scheme: Part (b) [1 mark]: W_parallel = 245 * sin(24.0 degrees) = 99.8 N (accept 99.7 N to 100 N).
Part (c) [1 mark]: W_perpendicular = 245 * cos(24.0 degrees) = 224 N (accept 224.0 N to 224.2 N).
hints: Weight is mass multiplied by acceleration of free fall (g = 9.81 m s^-2).
On an incline of angle theta, parallel component is W * sin(theta) and perpendicular component is W * cos(theta).
solution:
(a) W = 25.0 kg * 9.81 m s^-2 = 245.25 N approx 245 N.
(b) W_parallel = 245.25 * sin(24.0 degrees) = 99.8 N.
(c) W_perpendicular = 245.25 * cos(24.0 degrees) = 224 N.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Part (a): compute W = m * g = 25.0 * 9.81 = 245 N (1 mark).
Step 2: Part (b): parallel component is W * sin(24.0 degrees) = 245 * 0.4067 = 99.8 N (1 mark).
Step 3: Part (c): perpendicular component is W * cos(24.0 degrees) = 245 * 0.9135 = 224 N (1 mark).
